description: This file defines the CKTemplate class, which extends ROCmTemplate to generate code templates for AMD ROCm with specific focus on CK (Composable Kernel) headers and utility functions. It includes method definitions for generating headers, globals, type mappings, and runtime argument information within the context of code generation for GPU computations.

classes.name: CKTemplate
classes.description: A specialized template class for generating CK (Composable Kernel) code snippets tailored for ROCm GPU programming, encapsulating CK-specific headers, types, and runtime argument handling.

methods.name: IndentedBuffer header(self)
methods.description: Generates and returns the code buffer containing CK-specific headers and preprocessor directives tailored for GPU kernel code generation.

methods.name: IndentedBuffer globals(self)
methods.description: Produces a code buffer with CK global type definitions, constants, and utility aliases used across generated kernels.

methods.name: str torch_type_to_ck(self, node: IRNode, ptr: str)
methods.description: Maps a given torch IR node's data type to its corresponding CK type string and casts the pointer accordingly.

methods.name: list[ArgInfo] get_runtime_arg_info(self)
methods.description: Provides runtime argument metadata, specifically defining 'kBatch' as an int32_t argument.

methods.name: list[Any] get_runtime_arg_values(self, **kwargs: Any)
methods.description: Extracts runtime argument values from provided keyword arguments based on registered ArgInfo objects.

ctags.pattern: /^    def torch_type_to_ck(self, node: IRNode, ptr: str) -> str:$/
